title: Adoption boots mint gateway tokens nobody will ever present
body: startAttempt's adoption path calls the boot seam only to read base_sha, but the seam mints a fresh live run_gateway_token on every call, so each Workflow step replay inserts an inert live token row (used by nobody, killed only at the run's kill switch). Harmless today — the kill switch sweeps them — but a compose-without-mint seam would keep the token table an exact inventory of credentials containers actually hold. Cancel genuinely needs its mint (the salvage door pushes through it).
